== Overview ==

'''NintendoNotificationEventProtocol''' is used by the Wii U and 3DS friend servers to send clients notifications about friends.

== Methods ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Method ID !! Name
|-
| 1 || [[#ProcessNintendoNotificationEvent]]
|-
| 2 || [[#ProcessNintendoNotificationEvent]]
|}

=== ProcessNintendoNotificationEvent ===

Used by the server to send a client a notification. There is no known difference between the two methods, except that the server sends some events through method 1 and others through method 2. The client treats them exactly the same.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#NintendoNotificationEvent]] || Unknown || Notification data
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

== Classes ==

=== NintendoNotificationEvent ===

This class holds the data about a given notification. The contents of <code>m_dataholder</code> and how it is interpreted depend on <code>m_uiType</code>.

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || m_uiType || [[#Notification Types]]
|-
| [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || m_pidSender || The [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the user who triggered the action which caused the event
|-
| [[NEX/Types#DataHolder|DataHolder]] || m_dataholder || Actual event data. Contents depend on <code>m_uiType</code>
|}

=== NintendoNotificationEventGeneral ===

{{ClassInherits|path=Online/NEX/Types|Data}}

This class holds generic data about a given notification. The meaning of the fields changes based on the context the notification is sent in, the notification type, etc.

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || m_u32Param || Notification UInt32 paramater
|-
| UInt64 || m_u64Param1 || Notification UInt64 paramater 1
|-
| UInt64 || m_u64Param2 || Notification UInt64 paramater 2
|-
| [[NEX/Types#String|String]] || m_strParam || Notification string parameter
|}

=== NintendoNotificationEventProfile ===

{{ClassInherits|path=Online/NEX/Types|Data}}

This class holds data about a users profile.

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt8 || m_region || Users region ID. Likely <code>CFG_Region</code> on the 3DS, <code>MCPRegion</code> on Wii U
|-
| UInt8 || m_country || Users country ID. Unknown on the 3DS, likely <code>SCIGetCafeCountry</code> on the Wii U. See [[Nintendo_Network/Region IDs|Region IDs]]
|-
| UInt8 || m_area || Users area ID. Likely [[Nintendo_Network/Region IDs|Region IDs]]
|-
| UInt8 || m_language || Users language ID. Likely the standard set of language IDs Nintendo uses. See [[Nintendo_Network/IDBE#Languages|IDBE#Languages]]
|-
| UInt8 || m_platform || Users platform ID. Likely 0 = 3DS, 1 = Wii U (values from [[Nintendo_Network/NNAS|NNAS]])
|}

== Notification Types ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Method !! Platform !! Data Type !! Description
|-
| 1 || 1 || 3DS || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceProtocol#NintendoPresence|NintendoPresence]] || A friend updated their presence
|-
| 2 || 1 || 3DS || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceProtocol#GameKey|GameKey]] || A friend changed their favorite game
|-
| 3 || 1 || 3DS || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || A friend changed their comment. <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] the comment was updated, and <code>m_strParam</code> contains the new comment
|-
| 5 || 1 || 3DS || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || A friends Mii has been modified. <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] the Mii was updated
|-
| 6 || 1 || 3DS || [[#NintendoNotificationEventProfile]] || A friend updated their profile
|-
| 7 || 1 || 3DS || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || A provisional friend has added your card back. <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the LocalFriendCode of the user who added you back
|-
| 8 || 1 || 3DS || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || A friend deleted your friend card. <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] that the user was last online
|-
| 9 || 1 || 3DS || || A friend sent you an invitation. The client does not check the contents of <code>m_dataholder</code>
|-
| 10 || 1 || 3DS || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || A friend went offline. <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] that the user went offline
|-
| 10 || 1 || Wii U || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || A friend went offline. <code>m_pidSender</code> is the friend. <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] that the user went offline. The client clears the presence of the friend and stores <code>m_u64Param2</code> as the time they were last online
|-
| 21 || 2 || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#NNAInfo|NNAInfo]] || A friends Mii or profile has been modified. The client replaces the network account information of the friend in <code>m_pidSender</code>, and treats it as a Mii change if the Mii data differs, and as a profile change if the country or area differs
|-
| 22 || || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#PrincipalBasicInfo|PrincipalBasicInfo]] || A friends Mii has been modified. The client replaces the Mii of the friend in <code>m_pidSender</code>, and treats it as a Mii change if the Mii [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] differs
|-
| 23 || || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#PrincipalPreference|PrincipalPreference]] || The recipients preferences have been updated. <code>m_pidSender</code> is not read by the client. The client replaces its own preferences
|-
| 24 || 2 || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#NintendoPresenceV2|NintendoPresenceV2]] || A friend updated their presence. <code>m_pidSender</code> is the friend
|-
| 25 || || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#FriendRequest|FriendRequest]] || A new outgoing friend request. Only handled if <code>m_pidSender</code> is the recipient, in which case the client adds it to the recipients outgoing friend requests. The [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] in the [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#FriendRequest|FriendRequest]] is the user the friend request is going to. Ignored if that user is already a friend of the recipient
|-
| 26 || 1 || Wii U || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || An incoming friend request has been canceled. Sent with a non-zero <code>m_u64Param1</code>. <code>m_pidSender</code> is the user who sent the friend request. The client only checks that it is not the recipient. <code>m_u32Param</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] the friend request was going to (the recipient of the notification), <code>m_u64Param1</code> contains the the friend request ID that was canceled and <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] the friend request was canceled
|-
| 26 || 1 || Wii U || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || A friend has removed you from their friends list. Sent with an <code>m_u64Param1</code> of <code>0</code>. <code>m_pidSender</code> is the friend, and the client removes them from the recipients friends. <code>m_u32Param</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] the user being removed (the recipient of the notification) and <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] when the friend removed you
|-
| 26 || 1 || Wii U || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || If <code>m_pidSender</code> is the recipient, the client removes the friend whose [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] is in <code>m_u32Param</code>, or if there is none, the outgoing friend request to that user
|-
| 27 || 2 || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#FriendRequest|FriendRequest]] || New incoming friend request. <code>m_pidSender</code> is the user who sent the friend request. The client uses the [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] in the [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#FriendRequest|FriendRequest]] rather than <code>m_pidSender</code>, and ignores the friend request if that user is already a friend or has an outgoing friend request from the recipient. If <code>m_pidSender</code> is the recipient, the client instead adds it to the recipients outgoing friend requests
|-
| 28 || || Wii U || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || An incoming friend request has been removed. <code>m_pidSender</code> is not read by the client. The client removes the incoming friend request whose ID is in <code>m_u64Param1</code>, the same as after [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#DeleteFriendRequest|DeleteFriendRequest]]
|-
| 29 || || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#BlacklistedPrincipal|BlacklistedPrincipal]] || A user has been added to the recipients blacklist. <code>m_pidSender</code> is not read by the client. The client removes any incoming friend request from the user and adds them to the recipients blacklist, the same as after [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#AddBlackList|AddBlackList]]
|-
| 30 || 1 || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#FriendInfo|FriendInfo]] || Your outgoing friend request has been accepted. <code>m_pidSender</code> is the user who accepted it, but is not read by the client. The client adds the user in the [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#FriendInfo|FriendInfo]] as a friend, removes any outgoing or incoming friend request between the users, and flags the user as a new friend. See [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#PersistentNotification|PersistentNotification]]
|-
| 31 || || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#BlacklistedPrincipal|BlacklistedPrincipal]] || <code>m_pidSender</code> is not read by the client. The client adds the user to the recipients blacklist, or updates their entry if they are already blacklisted. Unlike type <code>29</code>, incoming friend requests from the user are not removed
|-
| 32 || || Wii U || || A user has been removed from the recipients blacklist. <code>m_pidSender</code> is not read by the client. The client removes the user whose [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] is in the first UInt32 of <code>m_dataholder</code> from the recipients blacklist, the same as after [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#RemoveBlackList|RemoveBlackList]]
|-
| 33 || 1 || Wii U || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || A friend changed their comment. <code>m_pidSender</code> is the friend. <code>m_u32Param</code> contains the <code>cafe.language</code> value of the comment, <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] the comment was updated, and <code>m_strParam</code> contains the new comment. If <code>m_pidSender</code> is the recipient, the client instead replaces its own comment, if <code>m_u64Param2</code> is newer than it
|-
| 34 || || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#PrincipalPreference|PrincipalPreference]] || Unknown. Likely the recipients friend request block setting has changed. <code>m_pidSender</code> is not read by the client. The client only reads the "block friend requests" field, and sets its own preference to it. If it is <code>false</code>, the client also clears the forced friend request block from [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#UpdateAndGetAllInformation|UpdateAndGetAllInformation]]
|-
| 35 || || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#ReceivedMessage|ReceivedMessage]] || Incoming friend requests have been marked as received. <code>m_pidSender</code> is not read by the client. The client marks the recipients incoming friend requests with the IDs in the list as received, the same as after [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#MarkFriendRequestsAsReceived|MarkFriendRequestsAsReceived]]
|-
| 36 || || Wii U || [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#PersistentNotificationList|PersistentNotificationList]] || Persistent notifications have been deleted. <code>m_pidSender</code> is not read by the client. For each type <code>30</code> notification in the list, the client clears the new friend flag of the user, the same as after [[NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceV2Protocol#DeletePersistentNotification|DeletePersistentNotification]]
|}
